_notes: What a generated pope is made of (E1 §3.1). Regnal names carry the ordinal last used as of 2025, so the next is one higher; Leo is left out, being the reigning pope's name (CLAUDE.md rule 13). Origins are weighted toward where the College's electors come from. Tunables are invented and flagged.
